text:
maria: Kicking off monitoring stack standup for new eu-west-3 GPU cluster. Need a concise checklist: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting templates, handoff. Timeline: provision completes tomorrow 09:00 UTC. who can own which areas? :wave:

samir: I can own metrics + alerting rules. main constraints: scrape cardinality and Prometheus remote_write throughput. also need guidance on retention vs cost.

jen: I'll take logs + traces. note: GPU driver logs are noisy (nvml). plan to filter at promtail/agent before pushing to Loki. trace sampling for model inferences should be 1-2% initially.

liam: I'll do infra networking + k8s service setup (private endpoints, VPC peering). reminder: no public egress from GPU nodes; metrics/ingest must go to private endpoints.

anya: I'll sign off on retention/cost tradeoffs and dashboard SLOs. from finance side we need a rough monthly spend estimate before retention >7d for logs.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-6791 (monitoring-standup-eu-west-3). Ops owner: liam. Links: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-6791

maria: Good. Let's capture an actionable checklist here. Short bullets > concrete commands where helpful.

samir: Metrics checklist (prometheus + remote_write):
- deploy prometheus-operator with `Prometheus` CRD, replicas=2
- node-exporter + kube-state-metrics + nvidia-smi exporter
- configure scrape config with low cardinality labels (no pod uid)
- enable `remote_write` to our long-term TSDB with write_shards=4 and max_samples_per_send=10000
- record rules for aggregated GPU utilization: `gpu:utilization:avg_over_time` and per-cluster queues
- alerting rules (initial): `GPUHighUtilization > 85% for 5m`, `PrometheusRemoteWriteErrors > 0`

Code snippet for nvidia exporter Helm values (example):
```
nvidiaExporter:
  enabled: true
  args:
    - --collect.gpu.utilization
    - --collect.memory.used
  scrape_interval: 15s
```

jen: Logs & traces checklist:
- promtail (or vector) as DaemonSet, drop nvml DEBUG lines via pipeline filter
- push to Loki via encrypted private endpoint (TLS + mTLS if possible)
- trace collector: Tempo (or Jaeger) with 7d raw retention, 90d index (sampling)
- instrument inference path spans (model_id, model_version, prompt_length, tokens_out)
- link traces to request_id in logs and metrics (use trace_id tag)

promtail pipeline example:
```
pipeline_stages:
  - drop:
      expression: "nvml"
  - regex:
      expression: "(?P<ts>^\\S+) (?P<level>\\w+) (?P<msg>.*)"
```

liam: Networking & bootstrap checklist:
- ensure subnets for GPU nodes have routes to monitoring VPC (VPC peering or PrivateLink)
- open outbound to Loki/Prometheus/Tempo endpoints on TLS port (443) and prom metrics port if on private IPs
- k8s: create `monitoring` namespace, RBAC for operators, limit-range to avoid runaway sidecars
- egress NAT for image pulls (if needed)

maria: Validation steps before handoff:
- Metrics: query `sum(rate(nvidia_gpu_utilization[5m])) by (node)` and check expected time series for each GPU node
- Logs: run a test workload (small synthetic inference) and confirm logs arrive in Loki with `request_id` attached
- Traces: send a synthetic request through inference API and confirm a span appears in Tempo with the model tags
- Dashboards: load Grafana dashboard `GPU Cluster Overview` and confirm panels show node count, avg GPU util, memory, temperature, and hot pod list
- Alerts: fire a test alert (use `ALERTS` test rule) and confirm Slack webhook and PagerDuty routing

samir: Example Prometheus alert (yaml):
```
- alert: GPUHighUtilization
  expr: avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization[5m]) > 0.85
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High GPU utilization on {{ $labels.node }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-high-util"
```

jen: Cost / retention notes (anya pls):
- logs: start with 3d retention for raw logs, index 30d; aggressively redact stacktraces/large payloads from logs to reduce ingress
- traces: sample 1% of requests for production initially; increase to 5% for problematic endpoints
- metrics: keep high-resolution (15s) for 7d, then downsample for long-term storage

anya: Finance ok with initial plan: 3d raw logs + 30d index, traces 1% sampling. If we need 7d raw logs we require formal approval due to projected +40% cost. I will sign off post-handoff if infra confirms expected ingress rate.

liam: Handoff plan:
- After validation, tag monitoring config as `eu-west-3/monitoring/GA` and create PR in infra repo
- On-call: rotate to `gpu-cluster` oncall for 48h of monitoring post-boot (config in ops/oncall.md)
- Runbook link added to alert annotations and to the cluster README

maria: Quick troubleshooting checklist (for first 24h):
- If no metrics: `kubectl -n monitoring get pods` -> check `prometheus` and `nvidia-exporter` logs
- If logs missing: verify promtail vector DaemonSet's network and TLS to Loki endpoint (`curl -v https://loki.internal/health` from a node)
- If traces missing: check Tempo ingress and sampling config

samir: Performance knobs to reduce cost under load:
- increase scrape_interval to 30s for less critical jobs
- reduce label cardinality (drop pod names, use service labels)
- use histograms with fewer buckets for high-cardinality metrics

jen: Dashboards to ship initially:
- GPU Cluster Overview (nodes, avg util, memory, temp, driver errors)
- Inference Request Latency (p50/p90/p99 by model)
- Log Errors by Service (top error messages)
- Trace waterfall for sample request_id

liam: Small network gotcha — Prometheus remote_write needs TLS SNI to match internal endpoint; set `scheme: https` and `tls_config:` in the config.

maria: Thanks all. next steps: liam opens PR for infra and network, samir submits prometheus + alerts PR, jen submits logs/traces helm values. anya to confirm cost estimate. We'll review in the 08:30 standup tomorrow before flip. :rocket:

ops-bot: INFRA-6791 status updated: "monitoring config PR opened" (https://redwood.internal/infra/PR/1182)

anya: Approving initial plan pending PRs. I'll join final validation at 08:30 UTC.

maria: closing thread — keep any post-validation notes in the PR and tag `eu-west-3/monitoring`. :thumbsup:
